title: Zesty Saudia Rice Flour Pancakes
description: These citrusy, dense rice flour pancakes are an Ayurvedic sattvic-friendly dish that can serve as a hangover cure in Saudia Arabian cuisine.
instructions: Sieve the rice flour and ground almonds together.
Add lemon zest, lime juice, cayenne pepper, turmeric powder, and coriander seeds to the mixture.
Gradually add water while stirring until you have a thick batter.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the pan, spreading them slightly with a spatula as they begin to bubble up.
Cook until golden brown on both sides and fluffy inside. Serve warm with your favorite citrus accompaniments.
